host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

cost.basis: deadline of 616s reached; no billing evidence

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus > test-log.txt 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib request_parts > test-log.txt 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --lib part_stems_worked plain_request_prose_is_unchanged >> test-log.txt 2>&1

cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib request_parts > test-log.txt 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --lib steward > test-log2.txt 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --lib replay >> test-log2.txt 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings > clippy-log.txt 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings > clippy-log.txt 2>&1
rm crates/athena-core/tests/zz_replay_probe.rs probe-log.txt clippy-log.txt policy-log.txt test-log2.txt && cargo test -p athena-core > test-log.txt 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-cli > test-log.txt 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test policy >> test-log.txt 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli > test-log.txt 2>&1
git diff crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs; ls -la test-log.txt; git diff CHANGELOG.md
rm test-log.txt && cargo fmt --all && cargo build --all-targets 2>&1 | grep -E "^(warning|error)" -A6 | head -80; echo done
rm test-log.txt && cargo fmt --all && cargo build --all-targets 2>&1 | head -80
rm -f test-log.txt && cargo fmt --all && cargo build --all-targets 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | cargo-nope 2>/dev/null; cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | tee /tmp/core-test.txt >/dev/null; echo exit $?

policy_denials.detail: git status | head && wc -l crates/athena-core/src/reading/*.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs && sed -n 470,560p crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs
grep -n "refusing_check(" crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs | grep -v "split\|fn " ; grep -n "^mod \|^pub mod \|^pub use \|^use " crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs | grep -v "^.*:    "
